author: Ifmyante
text:
Well

as yet, I still haven't found anybody to trade the fund. There's a giant
 chasm between pulling the trigger on one's personal account and trading
 other people's money!

The Academy, in fact, has organically turned into something else.

We now have a group of ten traders working together daily to pick the best setups, and it seems to be working really well.

Many of the calls in there are working absolutely beautifully, making for monster trades.

We will soon need to start training new traders to do the same, so we can have an A Team, B, and C.

Once we have the logistics of it sorted out, you can expect the doors of the Academy to be reopened.

You never know, our fund traders may be in the next class

author: Ifmyante
text:
There are too many people selling bad translations of RTM around the World.

In order to combat that, the wonderful Salivan has begun translating RTM
 into Persian, and we're working on setting up a space in here for him
to share the material and his journey in his own tongue.

Maybe we should have RTM in many other languages.

What do you guys think?

Having RTM in other languages will be a great idea too. But i think

because there will be a lot of work to do and a lot of question to be

So will be a big job to do and it can be done

That is a great idea. There is a huge amount of work to be done. Markepedia (followed by homework) is a good start, I think.

One worry is in my mind (sorry IF, slightly off topic). With RTM's
popularity increasing, I am guessing there will be some big ITs who "do
not like" the RTM, or other organisations. They could just buy RTM and
